name: recital
author: kcool101
description: Skip the green orb at 5.4% to end up as the reverse gravity ship and then start holding. Time a hold at 7.2%, shortly after releasing from the slope to go between the cube portal and spike. Land on the platform at 8% before the pink dash orb (you can fly into the spider orb) and then fall up a tiny bit, do a small hold to go near the first pillar with the musical note on it and then don’t click to fall above the level. Stay near the ceiling until 66% where you can start holding. Continue holding for the rest of the level.
